[contact omitted] Sophia Lajaunie Wednesday, October 5, 2022 at 3:20:44 PM Eastern Daylight Time
To: [contact omitted] Shannon Green, [contact omitted] Johnny Walsh, [contact omitted] Donald Steinberg,
[contact omitted] Jodi Herman, [contact omitted] Vera Zakem
Hi Shannon, Johnny, and all,
Thanks very much for joining our first ACVFA meeting on Friday. Lots of interesting ideas shared, and looking forward to
hopefully channeling that energy into some impactful outcomes.
As you saw there was clearly a lot of interest on the issue of dis/misinformation. This will likely be a main issue the
committee works on (likely a smaller subgroup of members would focus on it), and I'd love to set some time to hear your
thoughts on this as well as your reactions to the meeting in general. I am also restructuring our workplan proposal based
I am also adding +Vera Zakem here following the Administrator's note in a recent DWW (attached) regarding a potential
presentation on the Information Resilience Council at the next ACVFA meeting. Would love to discuss this and the IRC in
general, potential opportunities for collaboration/support, etc.
Let me know which days might work best this week or next and happy to send a calendar invite. Please also of course
add anyone else who should join. Also including +Donald Steinberg +Jodi Herman lead advisors for ACVFA.
Thanks all very much!
Sophia
Sophia Lajaunie (she/her/hers)
Executive Director of the Advisory Committee on Voluntary Foreign Aid (ACVFA)
Public Engagement Advisor
Bureau for Legislative & Public Affairs
U.S. Agency for International Development (USAID)

1. As discussed, we'd love if you could please share with us the following items, by Thursday COB if possible (so we
can then get this back out to the members):
a- The top 3-5 questions/challenges within the DRG & anti-corruption portfolios that you would like the ACVFA
working group on this to focus on (for now at least). As a reminder you had already shared these questions in the
initial draft workplan, in case they remain similar.
b- Which specific members (full list here) you are most interested in working with, see as resources to your work,
and/or have relationships with.
2. As part of the upcoming public meeting in early December (date TBC this week), we will likely have 2 separate
panels on different priority issues (speakers would include ACVFA members, potential outside experts/leaders, local
actors, etc.), one of which will fall in the DRG/AC umbrella. MDM is an option but may be too contentious given the
domestic context as discussed -- are there other key issues within this space you would like to see highlighted in this
first public meeting of the committee? e.g. could be a sort of follow up to the UNGA bright spots event, or focus on
tech, etc. Would love to hear your thoughts, keeping in mind this is our first public meeting so the topic we choose will
have added weight to it as an Agency priority.
3. Regarding the IRC conversation specifically, we'd love to at some point connect relevant members with you Vera
for a briefing and bring them into the external stakeholder workstream once ready - let's keep in touch on timing for
this as things develop on both our ends but wouldn't be until later next month at least.
Thanks all very much and happy to discuss further at any time.
Best,
Sophia
